exposure: implementation of recommendations/interventions for postpartum family planning
staff awareness of family planning importance
teamwork and engagement in postpartum family planning
cohort: The study included mothers who delivered at a teaching hospital in Rwanda and key staff in district hospitals.
finding: The implementation of evidence-based recommendations significantly increased postpartum family planning uptake from 26% (April 2022) to 89% (March 2025) at the hospital, with family planning counseling during pregnancy and staff teamwork being key factors.
mod_finding: Higher family planning uptake rates were observed after cesarean delivery (90%).
followup_time: Postpartum family planning uptake was recorded from April 2022 to March 2025.
